name: Divino
description: Uruguayan retailer of mattresses, sommiers, furniture, refrigerators, air conditioners and household goods, with its own online store on the Fenicio platform. States shipping to the whole country at a standard rate, with pickup centres in Montevideo.
description_es: Comercio uruguayo de colchones, sommiers, muebles, heladeras, aires acondicionados y artículos para el hogar, con tienda online propia sobre la plataforma Fenicio. Indica envíos a todo el país con tarifa estándar, y centros de retiro en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Shipping page states nationwide delivery. Standard rate UYU 990 for the rest of the country; delivery time depends on transport in each zone.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup centres in Montevideo; applies to bazaar and grocery purchases. Requires ID and order number; 30 days to collect.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: nationwide shipping, standard rate and pickup centres
